style.styleTitle: Personalised Memorial Photo Christmas Bauble with Gold Heart Charm by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised glass photo bauble serves as a memorial tribute to your loved one at Christmas. The photo is printed on one side onto a clear layer, which is then inserted into the bauble. The decoration is finished with a small engraved heart-shaped charm made from a mirror material and can be personalised with a short message such as their name and dates.<br>most personalised items will be delivered within 7 days. Estimated delivery will be confirmed at the point of order.<br><br>Please note that personalised items cannot be cancelled once your order is placed. Do not include accents, special symbols, or emojis as some of our processes will not allow this. These items are made especially for you, so they can only be returned if they are faulty, do not fit their description, or do not meet with your instruction.
